prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 课程表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "节次" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 81px
  col 3: header "周一" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 80px
  col 4: header "周二" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 5: header "周三" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 6: header "周四" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 27px
  col 7: header "周五" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 147px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周五天各节课的时间和课程，方便查看每日安排及比较同一时段的课程。","reading":"读者可按行查看某一节课在各天的安排，也可沿某一天的列向下查看全天课程；节次和时间共同定位每一行。","groups":["节次、时间：共同标识每一节课。","周一至周五：地位相同的日期列，需要便于横向比较。"],"keep_intact":["节次数字","时间范围，包括起止时间和连接符","简短课程名称，如语文、数学和英语"],"may_wrap":["较长的课程名称可在汉字之间自然换行，例如综合实践活动、信息技术与人工智能。","同一行中较短的课程可利用长课程换行产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [48, 102, 63, 57, 57, 57, 95] · table 480×260px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 73, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [48, 102, 65, 65, 65, 65, 69] · table 480×280px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 94, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [48, 102, 87, 48, 48, 48, 98] · table 480×260px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 73, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"节次与时间清楚地定位每一行；时间范围保持完整，周二至周四的列宽一致，短课程易于扫描。","problems":"周五的长课程占三行，使第三节明显偏高；周一的长课程也换成两行。周五比其他日期列宽，但仍未换得足够紧凑的排版。","cause":"周五宽95px，扣除21px后文字区为74px，容不下足够的汉字以排成两行；周一宽63px，文字区为42px，因此长课程换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"五个日期列宽度接近，视觉节奏均匀，时间和短课程保持完整。","problems":"周五长课程被挤成四行，第三节过高，其他日期在该行留下大片空白，削弱了横向比较的节奏。","cause":"周五仅宽69px，文字区为48px；平均分配日期列宽，没有照顾该列明显较长的课程名称。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"周一的长课程分成较自然的两行；周二至周四宽度一致，短课程和表头均完整。","problems":"周五的长课程仍占三行，第三节偏高；周一比三个中间日期列宽出不少，日期列的节奏不够均衡。","cause":"周一宽87px，文字区为66px，较两行排版所需的空间更宽；周五宽98px，文字区为77px，仍不足以让长课程排成两行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"friday-priority","widths":[48,102,75,50,50,50,104],"change":"从周一及三个中间日期列回收宽度，增加周五宽度，争取让最长课程排成两行；周一保留足够空间让长课程分两行，周二至周四保持一致。"},{"name":"more-friday-space","widths":[48,102,69,50,50,50,110],"change":"进一步增加周五宽度，为最长课程的两行排版留出余量；周一宽度仍可容纳短课程，并允许长课程换行。"},{"name":"monday-balanced","widths":[48,102,82,48,48,48,103],"change":"保留较宽的周一以改善长课程的断行，同时将周五增至103px；三个中间日期列等宽，提供另一种日期列比例。"}]}
